_warning: GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT. Built from the CSV by scripts/build-data.mjs; edits are lost on the next build. Edit the CSV, then run: npm run data:build

manufacturer.note: Brand name as the maker markets it, e.g. "Hodgdon", "IMR".

manufacturer_slug.note: Lowercase slug. Also the filename. All six powder brands referenced by these CSVs (accurate, alliant, hodgdon, imr, ramshot, vihtavuori) are present in manufacturers.csv, so all 169 rows resolve to a maker. That was not true until 2026-10-01 - see the references block below.

manufacturer_website.note: Maker's site. Present on most rows.

product_name.note: The powder designation, e.g. "H335", "N140", "VLR". This is the key a user searches for and the key the component finder hands to a retailer's search box. Powders have no SKU, so this field IS the lookup key.

product_line.note: Series the powder belongs to, e.g. "N100 series", "Hodgdon rifle". Used for grouping in the UI. Note several brands are the same company: Hodgdon owns IMR, Winchester, Accurate and Ramshot.

burn_rate_class.note: Drives the barrel-scaling exponent in the trajectory model. Filled ONLY where the manufacturer's own wording maps cleanly onto these four values. Splitting "medium" from "slow" rifle powder without a published chart would be a guess, so it is left blank rather than invented. See the accuracy doctrine in data/incoming/powders.md.

relative_burn_rate_position.note: Position on a manufacturer's burn-rate chart, 1 = fastest. Present for 22 of 27 rows in the curated set; the values live in data/seeds/powder_burn_rate_positions.csv. NOT COMPARABLE ACROSS BRANDS - position 7 in the Vihtavuori chart says nothing about Hodgdon 7. Never sort all powders into one global burn-rate number.

geometry.note: Single-base / double-base / triple-base. Empty on every row today. Useful for load-density and pressure-modder work, and the loader already infers is_double_base from this text when present.

notes.note: Free prose. This is where the maker's own wording is preserved, because it is often the only evidence for a classification decision. May contain commas, so it must stay quoted in the CSV.

source_url.note: Where this row was read. MANDATORY - the loader refuses a powder row without one. Provenance is the safety mechanism for load-adjacent data, not decoration.
